# FanCode

> > FanCode is India's premier digital sports destination offering live streaming, scores, highlights, and comprehensive coverage across cricket, football, Formula 1, MotoGP, golf, and other global sports.

FanCode provides fans with access to international and domestic tournaments including LALIGA, ISL, Copa del Rey, Carabao Cup, Formula 1 Grand Prix races, MotoGP championships, ICC cricket qualifiers, and emerging sports like TGL golf. The platform serves as a one-stop destination for live sports streaming, match schedules, race calendars, real-time scores, video highlights, and tournament information across multiple sports disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Live streaming
- Cricket scores and tournaments
- Formula 1 and Grand Prix racing
- LALIGA and Spanish football
- MotoGP motorcycle racing
- ISL (Indian Super League)
- Copa del Rey
- Carabao Cup
- Match schedules and fixtures
- 2025-26 season coverage
- Motorsports (F1, F2, MotoGP)
- Football standings and leagues
- TGL Season 2 golf
- International cricket tours
- Women's sports tournaments
